g.text: Graph revision AD - nozzle_orient: 14 schedule rows of docs-authority/nozzles/HDR_N2.csv at tag, face and bore

Graph revision AD - nozzle_orient: N1 DN50 drawn at the manifold centreline - the OD 60.3 hardware sits inside the 60.3 mm reservation cross-section (headers.py, AQS-DUTY-075; 2026-11-08 reservation adoption); N2 (sweep nitrogen) to N4 inlets on -Y at 11.3 mm (datum 10 clamped up); N13 inlet clamped down from the 160 mm placeholder datum

Graph revision AD - nozzle_orient: N5/N8 DN15 outlets at their 37 mm datum; N6/N7 DN25 outlets clamped down to 32.4 mm to keep the branch bore inside the cross-section; N11 and N14 (aisle make-up air) outlets and the N12 no-bore row (DN15 drawn, bore not calculated) clamped down from the 600 mm datum
Graph revision AD - nozzle_orient: N3/N4 carry services with no present edge on the graph; drawn verbatim, no edge created. N9 drain flush at the bottom, N10 vent flush at the top
